description: PTR - Tavola PT4 - Gerarchia insediativa: centralità e marginalità is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartografia.servizirl.it. Table PT4 recognises the elements of the regional polycentric system, as well as fragile areas of the territory. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PTR - Table PT4 - Settlement hierarchy: centrality and marginality" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include polarità, gerarchia insediativa, poli, ptr. The listing shows 2025-11-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
